card.name: Small words in results-reporting sentences
card.fires_on: Small words such as a, no, not or area right after verbs like show or based on in clinical study results. The next word is usually a finding, such as significant, differences or under the curve.

modes.label: Negated findings
modes.description: A or no/not right after 'did not show' or 'showed' when reporting no difference between groups.
modes.example: The results of an analysis of severity of skin-related adverse events showed<< no>> differences for subjects over 65 years

modes.label: Based on area under the curve
modes.description: The word 'area' after 'based on' when exposure is compared by AUC.
modes.example: Adverse embryo-fetal findings were seen at maternal exposures approximately equivalent to the human exposure at the recommended dose of 225 mg/day based on<< area>> under the curve (AUC).

modes.description: Words in methods text about sampling and coding periods.
